notes.title: "SAMURAI MAIDEN" Scheduled for release in this winter！
notes.content:
Beautiful as a cherry blossom, deadly as a samurai!


D3PUBLISHER's brand-new Girls Sword-fighting Action game "SAMURAI MAIDEN"
Scheduled for release in this winter for Steam!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38885408/1ec8563ddb3234d676ce69f03437281ba5fbd3b3.jpg

-Fixed the problem of lower framrate in specific environment

notes.title: Update Information (October 15th, 2020)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38885408/1ec8563ddb3234d676ce69f03437281ba5fbd3b3.jpg

Thank you for playing "Onee Chanbara ORIGIN".
We apologize for causing you any trouble while playing.
The bug which "Language setting is return to Japanese by restart the game" is fixed today.
We are continuing to find out what cause the bugs happened, and fix it as soon as possible we can. 
Thank you very much.
